name: responsive-explorer
goal: Keep same-revision navigation responsive with complete test and evidence semantics

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Measured 3251 ms Components click over 1244 units. Same-commit routes reset the loaded revision and repeat graph/verdict work.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog scale tests checked final content only; entity previews bypassed the console. Extend the shared fixture to exercise the real host with 1000 generated functions and unchanged tab, search and navigation assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 4c47462b: sealed e45efca8. Same-revision tabs detach content; Functions navigation 4463–4663 ms across three viewports. No browser errors.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus-authored raw revision state, primitive fetch keys and scoped graph readers. Codex review preserved revision and evidence semantics. Scale navigation 229–278 ms; all 559 unit and 45 browser tests passed.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: c06a64d2 passed sealed record 814b1839 against 741f842d red record 1270ca73: identical 1255 frozen inputs, command and environment. Category navigation 239–252 ms at three viewports.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 559 unit and 45 browser tests, type checks, lint, build, audit and registry checks passed. Full Harness verification remains pending while Electron checks are paused. Cache code exceeds frozen source-size and complexity budgets; limits remain unchanged pending review.
